habitats.name: Earth sea-level air (reference)
habitats.basis: Pressure from the challenge brief; 21% O2 is the standard approximation (the brief says 30% O2 is a >40% increase over Earth air).

habitats.name: Spacesuit
habitats.basis: Challenge brief: 100% oxygen at 4.3 psi. Gravity depends on location, so it is left null.

habitats.name: Moon base (expected intermediate atmosphere)
habitats.basis: Brief: likely 30% O2 or greater with pressure of 10.2 psi or less. Lunar surface gravity is a general reference value, not from the brief.

habitats.name: Pressurized lunar rover (expected)
habitats.basis: Brief expects Moon base and pressurized rover(s) at an atmosphere between spacesuit and Earth conditions; same expected bounds as the Moon base.

habitats.name: Mars surface habitat
habitats.basis: Atmosphere not specified in the brief (null). Martian surface gravity is a general reference value.

habitats.name: Spacecraft / space station in orbit
habitats.basis: Microgravity. Cabin atmosphere is not specified in the brief (null); fill from a cited source if needed.
